summary: Per-vertex MMX color blend over a fixed vertex count. For each vertex reads a source color dword at (this+0xC)+stride and a destination color dword at (this+0x20)+stride, unpacks both to words against qword_8B6C20, adds the blend offset qword_8B8E40, multiplies, shifts right by 8, packs back to bytes, and stores the result into the destination buffer. Clears MMX state with _m_empty() and returns the vertex count.

operations.description: Read vertex count at this+0x8; if not greater than zero, skip the blend loop.
Iterate once per vertex while the vertex index is below the count at this+0x8; source stride advances by 48 and destination stride by 64 per vertex.
Unpack source and destination color bytes to words using the zero word-mask qword_8B6C20.
Add the blend offset word qword_8B8E40 to the packed source words.
Multiply source and destination word lanes, shift right by 8, and pack back to bytes using qword_8B6C20.
Store the blended color dword back into the destination buffer at (this+0x20)+dest_offset+24.
Clear MMX state via _m_empty() after the loop.

unresolved: Semantics of the two word constants qword_8B6C20 and qword_8B8E40 (zero/unpack mask versus fixed-point blend offset) are interpreted from the MMX idiom, not from a labeled source.
